workflows.name: Moving Around
workflows.description: Switch between workspaces and move focus between windows.

steps.heading: Go to Workspace 2
steps.description: Workspaces are numbered. Jump straight to any of them.

steps.heading: Back to Workspace 1
steps.description: The same shortcut with a different number takes you back.

steps.heading: Next Workspace
steps.description: Cycle forward without naming a specific workspace.

steps.heading: Focus the Window to the Left
steps.description: Move focus by direction. The arrow keys and h j k l both work.
